parameters.name: accept
parameters.description: The specified server should return the response format as application/json.

async.description: Whether to process in asynchronous mode. When set to `true`, the interface immediately returns `task_id`, without the need to provide `callback_url`, and then the result can be obtained by polling the corresponding task query interface; if `callback_url` is also provided, the result will be pushed to that callback address.

model.description: The model used for generating videos, with a default value of `veo3-fast`, an example uses `veo31-fast`.

action.description: Types of actions for generating videos. `text2video` generates videos based on prompts; `image2video` generates videos based on 1-2 reference images (first frame, or first frame + last frame); `ingredients2video` generates videos based on 1-3 reference images, internally forcing the use of the `veo31-fast-ingredients` model (the model parameter will be ignored under this action); `get1080p` is a deprecated alias for `POST /veo/upsample` (`action=1080p`), retained only for backward compatibility.

prompt.example: White ceramic coffee mug on glossy marble counter, top with morning window light. Camera slowly rotates 360 degrees around the mug, pausing briefly at the handle.

video_id.description: The video ID that needs to be referenced is only valid when the action is `get1080p`.

image_urls.description: List of reference image URLs used when generating videos, valid only when the action is `image2video` or `ingredients2video`.

resolution.description: The resolution of the generated video can be `4k`, `1080p`, or `gif`, with the default value being `1080p`.

translation.description: Whether to enable automatic translation of prompts, the default value is `false`.

aspect_ratio.description: Set the aspect ratio of the video output, the upstream Veo only supports `16:9` or `9:16`.

callback_url.description: The callback URL that will be called after the video generation is complete.

example.prompt: White ceramic coffee mug on glossy marble counter, top with morning window light. Camera slowly rotates 360 degrees around the mug, pausing briefly at the handle.
